notes.title: Tales Of Glory 2 - MAin branch Updated : Stealth, Maps, Vehicles, Zip Lines
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=uN7ZKj2xy34;full][/previewyoutube]

GLOBAL :

- Full bHaptics support (body, head & arms)
- New ITF Only mode (you + ITF soldiers without Squad) accessible through map ratio + impact on EXP points
- Bug correction on Lone Wolf mode to make squad not visible and disable radio/orders
- Order added for natalya/medic to make her heal a down squad member automatically
- New map - Kazakhstan Infiltration
- Weapon Crates will heal you & refill grenades every 15 sec when your close enough 
- Voices made Taiwan mid sequence & Kazakhstan battle (arrival on plane)

VEHICLES : 

use left controller button A when close to go in/out
use left controller stick/pad up or down to accelerate/brake
grab the steering wheel with left and/or right hand to steer the vehicule
vehicule is semi full physic (collision with your hands /weapons but not body). you can run over enemies but will only make your teamates move away
if buggy is upside/down after a crash, you can flip it over by pushing it with your hands

- Buggy & Quad/ATV availlable in Syria, Russia, Kazakhstan & Guyana Battles
- Orders added to make squad jump in/ out in vehicle with you
- Vehicle control improved

ZIP LINES : 

- Zip line feature: grab the line with one hand and maintain trigger to slide
- Zip lines added in Syria Battle & Mogadihu Infiltration

STEALTH ENGINE :

- Full rewrite of Infiltration AI. Enemies behavior is greatly improved. 
They will communicate more, react to bullets impacts, rocks thrown,  with different steps of awareness, and chase you throughout the map if needed.
- Dead body detection improved
- Reinforcements mechanic improved

- SEMI BREAKING CHANGE : 3 new keywords are available in voice recog for Infiltration --> These keywords need to be set or voice recog will be deactivated
- "Hey" keyword will lure the enemy to your position
- "Drop your Gun" & "On your knees" orders --> You need to point a gun toward the enemy and be 5m close to him and just say the keyword. Enemy will either do it or react (return fire, escape and yell).
- Enemy will yell if not complying to an order (drop their gun/knee down). you will have 0.5 sec to kill him.

- Melee weapons added in all infiltration maps (Wrench, Crowbar, Pipe, Axe, Hammer, etc)
- Soda cans added in all interior infiltration maps (same use as rocks). throw them to lure patrols somewhere
- Rock pickup on ground improved
- Taiwan infil map improved with countdown sequence when detected
- Alarm moved to second floor on Taiwan Infil map
- Night vision flickering issue (unity bug) resolved with a workaround


Cheers 

Jay

notes.title: Tales of Glory 2 Updated
notes.content:
TOG 2 has been updated with the following features :

- New map : Somalia infiltration (in test)

Full 3d directionnal sound : Official spatializer plugins were not able to handle the load of TOG2 so i had to write my own lightweight spatializer code :
- HRTF-based spatialization for battles
- HRTF + Occlusion for infiltration missions
I've also added a lot of new sounds/voices for ITF soldiers and for enemies in infiltration

- Huge improvment on ITF pathfinding : Note that the pathfinding improvment is a game changer in the way npcs navigate so game might be more easy/more difficult than before


- Map zoom (press pointing controller button 1 to zoom on last selected position on map)
- Syria infiltration finished with secondary objective (plant C4)
- Mission auto restart on death + option to quit to main menu
- Small bug on lasersight corrected
- Waypoints on map for ITF soldiers have been renamed Wa, Wb, Wc (for alpha, bravo, charlie) 
- i've added new symbols on map A, B, C representing average position of each ITF soldiers squad so you can monitor their progression
- RPG having only one rocket then switching to smg guy
- Grenades are back for npcs
- Npcs now drop their weapons on death (but still can't pick em up)
- New weapon (locked) : Minigun....

- Reworked Scopes + New scopes  Aimpoint + Magnifier & Variable scope 4x/8x
- Limping NPCs when hit in legs
- Reworked Russia High beach zone to prevent pathfinding issue
- Night vision can be switched on/off while tablet in hand
- Ratio accessible on battle selection in main menu 
- Ratio + difficulty + nb on active NPC will modify XP granted
- new moves for NPC (strafing 45° & 135° left & right when firing)
- ITF soldiers spawning will join their squad faster
- Magnifier rotation issue with left hand corrected
- Aimpoint + magnifier dot color changed to red
- Reworked Guyana for pathfinding
- Ratio changing difficulty issue corrected
- Somalia main menu visual added
- Added targets pictures on tablet in infiltration mission
- Scope dots are illuminated
- Improved bullet trails when enemies fire at player to give some additional clues on the bullets origin
- Tutorial improved

- lot of small bugs corrected here and there (ammo count when bullet chambered) / Switching suppressor on/off for a weapon is hand doesn't change the sound , etc

Cheers,

Jay

notes.title: Tales of Glory 2 - Main game updated with all beta content
notes.content:
Main game has been updated  with the following features :

- New battle map : Somalia
- New enemies outfits
- New enemies audio & voices 
- Radio only activated by left or right hand depending on hand config
- Radio only activated if hand empty
- Dead bodies deactivation improved to prevent piles of corpses
- HK G36 added in assault categorie (unlocked)
- Enemies will also use some G36
- New slide feature : is you press both triggers when climbing, you'll slide down along the surface. usefull for ladders & for chopper rope because i'll be adding fall damage soon
- Russia infiltration finished with secondary objective : hacking a computer in the house before killing the target. The hack mechanic is top notch. There's an exemple in lobby
- New M249 sound
- Enemies precision decreased a bit
- Toogle grip possible for tablet
- Increase throwing range for grenades
-  Toggle grip bugs corrected
-  Night vision partial illumination bug with new outfits corrected
- Add bolt catch/release for AR15 type weapons & handguns. To release the bolt, press the same button as firing mode
- Increase a bit flashlight cone
- Remove muzzle flash when suppressed
- Scope shadow when not active
- Correction on Guyana vegetation to better see enemies
- Tablet can be grabbed with one hand
- Night vision switch on/off without removing hand
- Switch cinematic cam raycheck
- Momentary addon Laser/Flashlight. if second hand is grabbing the weapon, maintain second hand trigger pressed to momentary activate the addon
- NPC Head not animated issue corrected
- Better NPC Ragdoll Physics on Explosion death. (throw a grenade in lobby to see it  )
- ITF Soldiers will spawn on the closest spawnpoint of their Group
- Healing/Grenade refill constant order bug corrected
- Guyana Pathfinding under house stair issue corrected
- Decrease Night vision NPC illumination
-  Huge work on AI & Pathfinding
- Head can't go through walls anymore
- XP farming issue corrected
- Taiwan battle occlusion flicker corrected
- Menu laser warping corrected
- Removed total nb of npc option in menu
- Foregrip added on AR15 , SIG MPX & AAC HoneyBadger
- Increased recoil for AK47 & AK12
- Npcs can't fire through walls improved


More to come soon

Cheers,

Jay

following the feedback on Discord & Steam hub, i'm pushing the actual beta to main with the following features :

- Second hand position fixed 
- Shotgun available for ITF soldiers
- Taiwan infiltration start bug 
- Make grenades not visible when empty 
- Make NPC reload their weapon before mag is empty and in cover 
- Magazine issue on dual weapon 
- 10X Scope added on G3 
- Scope performance review 1st step 


- Switch buttons for Mag release / FiringMode  for 2  buttons controllers only (Done)
--> Button 1 = Firing Mode
--> Button 2 = Mag release
--> Stick up = Jump
--> Stick down = Kick

Vive wands & WMR users stays with the previous config (need to enable One button mode on main menu)

- additionnal scope perf upgrade
- rotation of handguns issue when second hand is mounted corrected
- new weapon sounds
- XP not saving fixed
- Taiwan RPG removed 
- Toggle grip on second second hand fixed
- Syria pathfinding issue 
- Haptic feedback for knife & punch & headsmash & buttstock hit 
- Change NPC Sniper AI to use more Height cover
- Remove Pin on grenades thrown by npcs  & spoon too
- Make npcs throw bangs
- Changed Taiwan Quantum/ITF ratio
- Prevent Npc from firing through walls sometimes (Done but will need feedback)

- Grenades / bangs / Smoke reworked with cooking.  Need to press & maintain trigger on hand holding the grenade to unpin. If trigger is released after unpinning, you'll let go the spoon. <-- i suggest you try the new mechanic in Lobby :laughing: 

- Bipod issue corrected
- Color Dots on sights for all handguns
- Some Taiwan pathfinding issue corrected
- Squad orders not working sometimes bug fixed
- Natalya bugged when healing corrected
- Added heal percentage on down teamate
- Natalya/Zaak moving directly to you when calling Heal/Ammo even if you move to another place
- Avatar blocked on small obstacle fixed : you'll be able to go over obstacles up to 40cm without jumping
- Loadout issue fixed
- Russia occlusion bug fixed
- Lot of work on Taiwan/Guyana (breakable windows, vegetation issue, some lod issues, etc)
- Corrected gaze locomotion

Cheers

Jay
